coordinate_note: rect is [x,y,width,height] in atlas pixels. pivot/anchors are local to that rect. Use custom regions, not fixed cells. Screen-left/right naming. Origin/pivots below are integration suggestions, not a tested character fit.

front_shell.use: Wall-hanging body. No attached long shoulder straps or carrying loop. Front pocket's two short buckle-closure straps intentionally remain.

side_shell.use: Three-quarter side body for behind-character wear. Put shell and far strap behind body; expose only side portion appropriate to character orientation. Mirror if needed rather than placing full shell in front.

near_strap.use: Independent curved padded strap with buckle and hidden overlap tabs. In wear state, top behind shoulder and visible strap segment above torso clothing; mesh/bone deformation recommended for shoulder bend.

far_strap.use: Independent darker shoulder strap. Keep behind character torso except any visible far-shoulder sliver. Separate damped motion in wall state.

top_loop.use: Independent inverted-U carrying/hanging loop. Pin apex at wall hook during hanging. Hide bottom tabs behind shell upper edge, permit small damped local flex.

assembly_notes: Original whole travelbag_closed.png preserved. Atlas components are real raster cutouts, not procedural replacement polygons.

Match body rest size to original source before adding independent straps. Shell, straps and handle are not equal atlas scale after generation; inspect character fit instead of assuming one shared unit scale.

Preserve front/back draw ordering per mode: wall: far strap, near strap, loop tabs behind shell; worn: far strap and side shell behind character, near strap above character at shoulder/torso, with attachment tips hidden.
Each long strap has separate upper/lower endpoints and can be skinned to multiple joints; do not move one entire foreground polygon as a substitute.
qa: Inspected original, first generated atlas, corrected atlas and final 1024 PNG. First generated front shell retained a dangling shoulder remnant at left; targeted second built-in edit removed it. No GPU wearing/hanging interaction acceptance.
